newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian housing market seen ready to rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian housing market seen ready to rise.

text.p: Australia's housing market is showing general increases in trend dwelling prices and rents, the Real Estate Institute of Australia (REIA) said on Sunday.
While monthly prices fluctuated, moving annual median house prices were up on June in all capitals except Canberra and Adelaide, the REIA said.
REIA President Phillip Bushby said the figures were a sign the long awaited recovery in the housing market is on the way.
There were also signs of a tightening in the rental market.
"Oversupplies of housing generated in the early 1990's are starting to be exhausted," Bushby said.

Agents in Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane were reporting difficulty in obtaining new listings, and Sydney and Melbourne had rental vacancy rates of under three percent, indicating a shortage of rental housing, he said.

"July saw a significant increase in the number of dwellings financed, one of the most important forward indicators of the housing market, suggesting further growth is likely in the near future," Bushby said.
